description: A Bernoulli gate: each gate that arrives is sent to one of two outputs by chance, with the odds set by a knob

params.text: Sets how likely an arriving gate is to go to the B output, never at 0% and always at 100%; the maker's README describes it the other way round
Picks which of 128 fixed random patterns this module follows, so the same seed can give a different run of decisions here

inputs.text: Takes the decision over from the knob entirely, -5V sending every gate to A and +5V sending every gate to B
The gate to be routed; it counts as high past 1V and is armed again below 0.1V
A rising edge past 1V sends the decisions back to the start of the pattern

outputs.text: Carries 10V for as long as the incoming gate is high, whenever the decision went this way
Carries 10V for as long as the incoming gate is high, whenever the decision went this way

notes: without latch mode both outputs fall to 0V as soon as the incoming gate does, so the outputs copy the shape of what you feed in
menu: Latch mode — holds the chosen output at 10V after the incoming gate falls, until the next gate arrives and a new decision is taken

inputs.0:
±5V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads the knob's own position.
inputs.1:
high above 1V · stepped · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage does nothing here.
